verdict.headline: Almost: 2 items still need your confirmation.

checks.label: Python 3.9 or newer
checks.why: The engine, the workbook builder and the adapters are Python.
checks.fix: Install Python 3 from python.org, or run: brew install python3

checks.label: PyYAML installed
checks.why: The profile is YAML so a person can read and edit it.
checks.fix: pip3 install pyyaml

checks.label: openpyxl installed
checks.why: Builds the profile workbook and the Excel tracker.
checks.fix: pip3 install openpyxl

checks.label: Claude Code available with an active subscription
checks.why: The skills, the browser control and the approval steps all run inside Claude Code.
checks.fix: Install the Claude desktop app and sign in. If the org pays for it, ask IT for a seat.

checks.label: KPI Copilot plugin is loaded
checks.why: Without it the /kpi-copilot:* skills do not exist.
checks.fix: claude plugin marketplace add "<the KPI Copilot folder>" then claude plugin install kpi-copilot@pm-tools. Or skip installing: start Claude with --plugin-dir pointing at this folder.

checks.label: A profile exists for you
checks.why: The profile is what makes the run follow your workflow instead of somebody else's.
checks.fix: Run /kpi-copilot:kpi-setup and answer the interview.

checks.label: Profile has every required section
checks.why: A half-filled profile produces numbers nobody can defend.
checks.fix: Re-run /kpi-copilot:kpi-setup; it resumes where it stopped.

checks.label: KPI definitions synced from PMS
checks.why: Ids, the default targets and any target this project sets for itself come from PMS, not from a copy that quietly went out of date.
checks.fix: python3 scripts/kpi_registry.py --refresh  (needs a signed-in PMS session)
checks.detail: using the bundled fallback from Sept 2026

checks.label: Adapter 'csv' exists (project atlas)
checks.why: The adapter is what turns that project's tracker into something the engine can read.
checks.fix: Pick one of: asana, jira, csv. For anything else run /kpi-copilot:kpi-adapter to write one.

checks.label: PMS answers from this machine
checks.why: If PMS is unreachable there is nowhere to send the result.
checks.fix: Check the VPN and the URL. If the host is right and still unreachable, ask IT.
checks.detail: DNS lookup failed for pms.example.com: [Errno 8] nodename nor servname provided, or not known

checks.label: Your account can open the project's KPI page in PMS
checks.why: Being able to read PMS is not the same as being allowed to see this project.
checks.fix: Open <pms>/all-projects/<id>/kpis in the browser. If it refuses, ask the PMS admin for access to that project.
checks.detail: confirm by opening the page while signed in

checks.label: Your issue tracker answers from this machine
checks.why: Everything starts with reading the board.
checks.fix: Check the URL and the network.

checks.label: A browser session signed in to the tracker, PMS and your document store
checks.why: Claude reads these pages as you. It never types credentials, so the session has to be there already.
checks.fix: Sign in yourself in Claude's browser pane, or connect the Claude in Chrome extension on the work profile. Then re-run this check.
checks.detail: sign in once; the session is remembered

checks.label: Agreed scope / project plan
checks.why: Scope and planned dates come from here when the tracker is not the agreed truth.
checks.fix: Add it on the Sources tab of the profile workbook, or accept that the KPIs it feeds will say 'Not measured' and why.
checks.detail: not needed - this profile treats the tracker as the single source of truth

checks.label: Additional effort estimates
checks.why: Change requests and their hours come from here.
checks.fix: Add it on the Sources tab of the profile workbook, or accept that the KPIs it feeds will say 'Not measured' and why.
checks.detail: not needed - this profile treats the tracker as the single source of truth

checks.label: Timeline / date change log
checks.why: Date revisions and handovers come from here.
checks.fix: Add it on the Sources tab of the profile workbook, or accept that the KPIs it feeds will say 'Not measured' and why.
checks.detail: not needed - this profile treats the tracker as the single source of truth

checks.label: At least one evidence channel
checks.why: Dates, handovers and decisions are proved with links. With no channel, those cells come back empty and need filling in by hand.
checks.fix: List your chat spaces or mail threads on the Tools tab and reference them from Sources.
checks.detail: not needed - source of truth is tracker-only

checks.label: A run has a bounded reach
checks.why: Without a time range and per-source caps every refresh re-reads the whole history of every board and channel. That is slower and costs more without being more accurate.
checks.fix: Set scan.window (period+grace suits most teams) and, on a long-running board, scan.tracker_scope: touched-since.
checks.detail: source of truth tracker-only; window period+grace, board touched-since

checks.label: Run output folder is writable
checks.why: Each run keeps its extract, results and payload so a number can be traced back months later.
checks.fix: Pick a folder you own in the profile's output.run_folder.

checks.label: You know who approves a push
checks.why: Numbers that reach management should have had a person look at them.
checks.fix: For assisted-push that person is you. If your team wants a second reviewer, name them on the Output tab.
